passages.text:
Re: Facebook Training
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Whittney Tom Tuesday, November 16, 2021 at 8:18:38 AM Eastern Standard Time
To: [contact omitted] Mariam Abdoh, [opaque block] [contact omitted] Ahmad Shehada
Hi Mariam,
Thank you for reaching out! Our Health Partnerships' program on health behavior change for COVID is only for health
nonprofits and UNICEF this year. We have plans to make thetraining more widely available in the coming year or two
through a more open community of practice model. Ahmad and his team continue to support the local USAID mission in
Jordan as his team (Government, Policy, and Nonprofits, or GPN, at Meta) works with government organizations. Are
there specific topics that you all are looking for additional training on?
Best,
Whittney
Whittney Tom
(she/her)
Health Partnerships
From: Mariam Abdoh <[contact omitted]>
Date: Sunday, November 14, 2021 at 11:41 PM
To: Whittney Tom < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>, Ahmad Shehada < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Facebook Training
Hi Whittney and Ahmad,
The trainingI referred to was "Facebook for Health Behavior Change" and it lasted for 6 weeks. Do you have any plans to
conduct something similar this year?
I would appreciate your kind response to my email earlier.
Regards,
Mariam
On Sun, Nov 14, 2021 at 5:22 PM Mariam Abdoh <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Dear Whittney and Ahmad,
This is Mariam, Project Management Specialist at USAID mission in Jordan, I have reached you through our
implementing partner FHI360 who are implementing our Community Health and Nutrition project in Jordan. I'm
currently leading this project from the USAID side. I have learned that you have provided the team with an incredible
training for SBCC COVID-19/ Vaccine campaigns focusing on the social media platforms a few months ago. I wonder if

you are planning to reopen that training again? I would also like to know what are your plans for the capacity building
opportunities during the coming year for individuals to enroll?
I will highly appreciate it if you can respond to me by tomorrow with the estimated cost/ expected time if possible.
Thank you again and looking forward to hearing from you.
Regards
Mariam
Mariam Abdoh
Project Management Specialist, Population and Family Health Office
U.S.AGENCY FOR INTERNATIONAL DEVELOPMENT | USAID-JORDAN
